mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_graph_history (tenant_id, workflow_id, xml, node_count, edge_count) SELECT #{param1}, w.id, w.graph->>'xml', (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_node n WHERE n.workflow_id = w.id AND n.node_type = 'task'), (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_edge e WHERE e.workflow_id = w.id) FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.id = #{param2} AND w.graph->>'xml' IS NOT NULL
INSERT INTO workflow_edge (tenant_id, workflow_id, from_key, to_key, edge_type) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, 'sequence') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow SET graph = jsonb_set(COALESCE(graph, '{}'::jsonb), '{xml}', to_jsonb(#{param3}::text)), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", code AS "code", name AS "name", category AS "category" FROM workflow WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY id
SELECT workflow_id AS "workflowId", from_key AS "fromKey", to_key AS "toKey" FROM workflow_edge
